summary: The agent builds a robust multi-seed Stratified K-Fold LightGBM pipeline with extensive domain-specific feature engineering. However, it introduces critical data leakage by calculating frequency encodings on the combined train and test dataset. Furthermore, it ignores the temporal nature of the earthquake data during splitting, evaluates using only accuracy despite potential class imbalance, and relies on an unweighted average for ensembling.
